name: mar-language-support
description: Syntax highlighting, snippets, and LSP support for the Mar programming language.

mar.serverPath.description: Path to the mar binary used to launch the language server. Override if `mar` isn't on your $PATH.

languageModelTools.name: mar_reference
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Look up a name in the Mar language reference: its exact type signature, what it does, and worked examples that a test evaluates and requires to be True. Mar is a small language that is not in your training data, so guessing a signature from another language will be wrong. Call this before writing any Mar stdlib call. Accepts a qualified name (List.map, Decimal.toCents), a module-less one (not, always, linkTo), or a prefix (Decimal.to) to see what exists.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Look up a name in the Mar reference

name.description: The Mar name to look up, or a prefix of one.

scripts.compile: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
